name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
description: A side effect of the Sylex blast that locked twelve worlds off from the multiverse, keeping the Phyrexians out.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betray the others; Szat kills Chromium so they can escape to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Chromium, who was powerful enough to allow them to escape

timeline.summary: Taysir is trapped in the Shard on Dominaria and falls in love with Kristina of the Woods on Corondor.
timeline.quote: he met and fell in love with a fellow planeswalker Kristina of the Woods .

timeline.summary: The Shard of the Twelve Worlds is destroyed and the Ice Age ends.
timeline.quote: The Shard of the Twelve Worlds is destroyed, and the Ice Age comes to an end.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, devastating Dominaria; the resulting Shard keeps the Phyrexians out and Yawgmoth has Gix imprisoned in the 7th Sphere.
timeline.quote: A furious Yawgmoth had Gix thrown into the 7th Sphere of Phyrexia, where he would be tortured for all eternity.
